description: A chat prompt, and a position inside one of its turns. The `chat` column holds a list of {'role', 'content'} messages rather than a string, so the run renders it through the checkpoint's own chat template and records where each turn landed; a position may then name a turn the way it names a variable. `blanked` zeroes, and reads, the last token of the SECOND user turn — `{'segment': 'user[1]'}`, because the conversation has two and a bare 'user' is ambiguous, the same rule a variable that occurs twice gets. The template's control tokens are between the turns and in none of them, so the position is the question's own last token and not `[/INST]`.
